title: THE BIBLE : THE BOOK OF OUR FATHERS | Traumatizing Knees Of Pressure!! Leviticus 26

sense.text:
The vile person shall be no more called liberal: You see that? That's why Bishop is bringing these things out through the prophets. The vile person, this man Esau, shall no more be called what? Liberal.

Nor the churl said to be bountiful: Now notice the description the Most High gives them.

For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity: His heart will work iniquity. It's iniquity constantly in this man's mind. That's why we read the statement earlier: oh, he appeared to be under medical distress. What the hell are you talking about? It's three y'all on this man's back, one on his neck. He appeared to be.

The vile person: This liberal man, so-called Democrat, Republican, the Bible calls him vile. This man is wicked. And that's what's going to bring out the vileness of them. But as long as the Bible is not here, that's why they're trying to get rid of the Bible, because without the Bible the natural born killer will continue to be out there looking as a saint, looking like he's about justice and all that, where we are confusing justice with accountability. This is madness.

Revelation 13:10: You're not getting justice when the people that set up an unjust system is, quote unquote, measuring out justice. That's not justice. Justice is in Revelation. Let's read justice out the Bible right now.

He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: That's the definition that we saw earlier. Equity.

He that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword: That's supposed to be a knee on Derek Chauvin's neck. As a matter of fact, all these people supposed to be in jail, because they on stolen land.

Here is the patience and the faith of the saints: In other words, that's when justice is met. So if you ain't talking about this, you're not talking about justice.

precepts.why:
“For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee”: What did the Most High say? As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee.

“Thy reward shall return upon thine own head”: That's justice right there. Thy reward shall return upon thine own head. That is justice right there. Okay, what do they mean, in God we trust? Just the fact that you're saying that, and then you ain't doing what the Bible says, what kind of justice are you talking about?

sense.text:
As for us: The children of Israel.

Our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: Don't forget about all that. Our eyes have failed for the vain help, down through generations.

In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us: See, despite this, they still will not save us. This still cannot save us. Like you said, Bishop, maybe we look for just a little bit of hope, but it's still not going to save us.

Lamentations 4:20: The scripture that you pulled in Lamentations 4, now read verse 20 also, because it's going along. They keep using exhale, breath and all of that.

The breath of our nostrils: Then in verse 21, it's talking about Edom. So it's ironic: it says breath there, and we're going into this being suffocated.

I also will do this unto you: Because we disobey God's laws. Let's keep that in our front lines, okay? Because we broke the commandments of the Most High, and that sent the judgment from the Most High against us, and this is one of the consequences of us breaking our Father's commandments.

I will even appoint over you terror: Stop right there. Terror. That's what I want to get to now. Black people and the Israelites, the 12 tribes of Israel, are a terrorized people. We are a terrorized people. That's what I want to bring out now. The traumatizing knees of pressure have brought a level of terror in our lives, and that's what I want to talk about now. Again, going back to that statement that somebody's talking about the Bible is fiction and all that, we're going to find out that the Bible is real, just as real as anything you can even imagine. We're going to bring out some real terror now, and all of us have felt this, that the Bible is talking about us. We're the 12 tribes of Israel. Never forget that thing. The Israelites. Those of you that came over here through the slave trade, those of you that's involved in that, suffered throughout the Hispaniola, suffered throughout Cuba, suffered all over the world, because the Israelites were scattered all over the planet. The Sub-Saharan slave trade and the Transatlantic slave trade, the Israelites went through that. All 12 tribes went through that thing. So you're the Israelites that the Bible speaks of.

I also will do this unto you: I will also do this to my 12 tribes of Israel.

I will even appoint over you terror: We ain't got to read the rest of the verse. I'm gonna stop right there. Terror. That's what we're gonna talk about now. We're going to talk about terror, we're going to talk about post trauma and how it affected us, and we're going to talk about how the Lord gave us the mind-bending solution, that cause us to work together in faith, so that we can get the hell out of here. So we're gonna bring all of that out to you in this last hour, Lord willing. The Bible has a solution to our people's problem. We're getting ready to bring that out to you now.

Terror: You just can't let those words go by. His what kind of body? His mangled. Listen to the description. His mangled body. Why would his body be mangled? And it was some fisherman, a boy, found his body. So they were never even going to report that. Had that fish hook line never caught that boy's body, we would have never known what happened to Emmett. The mother would have just, her son disappeared out the house, we never seen him again. Just think about that. Talk about terror.

Terror: Listen. A 75 pound cotton gin fan, wrapped around with barbed wire, wrapped around his body, and thrown into the river. Why would you do that? Because you know his body gonna come up. Because if you never thought that anybody was gonna see it, why would you do the things to this boy the way you did it, the way these bastards did it? Why would you do that? Because you know that somehow, some way, that body is gonna come up, and we're gonna see the terror that was done to that boy. And that was designed to inflict terror on our people.

Terror: He tried to have the body hidden. So they didn't have a problem with all of the evil that was done. They tried to hide the body, because if the world finds out about this, that area is going to lose money. That area is going to feel the pressure of the outside. That's the reason why they had a problem with Malcolm speaking in the UN. They did not want the outside world to shine the light on the ugliness of how this country was dealing with our people. That's when Malcolm got in trouble, when he started really talking like that. They say, you're talking too much. Same thing like they're doing us.

Terror: The question that she asked, she said, was it necessary to shoot him? The answer is, according to them, yes. In other words, it was absolutely necessary for us to do all of the evil that we did to him. Why? To inflict terror. Read that Leviticus again. That was the purpose of why she's asking why. The answer is because the objective of the evil that they did, like when they dragged Byrd behind that truck in Jasper, Texas, that was to inflict terror. What are you talking about, the Bible ain't talking about us?

I will even appoint over you terror: Terror. What he will appoint? Terror. Terror. Terror. Spell it, T-E-R-R-O-R. That's terror, the root word of terrorism. So the terrorists is these damn people that bring it up, these people that's inflicting terror on us. Hey, I can use the word damn. We get all sensitive and all of that, but that's exactly what we're dealing with. We're dealing with a terrorist organization.

I will even appoint over you terror: Terror, terror, terror. So our people terrorized. So that's the reason why they tied a 75 pound gin fan around his neck with barbed wire, to rip his body up, barbed wire, and throw him in the river, knowing that his body was going to come up and that the parents will see that and be forever tormented, be forever terrorized. This is what's wrong with us. A terrorized people. And they're expecting justice? No, man, we're not going to get it here. God got to bring the justice. That's the only way we're gonna get the justice.

Terror: This right here is about Darnella, the witness that recorded George Floyd's death. 17 years old. I want y'all to pay attention now. I played some of this last week, and I wanted to hit it again. I think I kind of rushed through it last week, but now this time I'm going to take my time with it and get all the points out. This is the Derek Chauvin trial, of the murder of George Floyd.

Terror: You see the car doors open on the police cruiser, on the truck there? So George Floyd is on the other side of that truck being squeezed to death, and these kids, they were walking, the 17 year old and her cousin, they're walking towards the Cup Foods store, and she notices this. The older one, she notices this, and her objective is to protect my young cousin from seeing this. And when I talked about that last week, because that trauma is evident all the way from back in slavery up to tonight.

Terror: You hear her voice? You hear how her voice is starting to break, because the trauma and the terrorism is settling back in, the realization of that thing.

Terror: She said she seen he was terrified. Biblical prophecy again fulfilled. The Most High said he would appoint over us terror. So she saw it in George Floyd when she walked by, spoken right out of her mouth. So you say the Bible's fiction? Where are they getting this stuff from? They know it ain't fiction. They want us to believe it because they think that we follow them so much, if they say it, then we'll say it.

Terror: That's what I wanted to get to last week. I didn't get this far. I want to get to these points. I want you to understand what's going on in my sister's head, and the trauma.

Terror: She saw the picture before we did. So when she saw the picture, you just hear her breath, the gasping, all of that happening, because seeing this maniac brought terror. That's a symbol of terror to her. He might as well just had on a hood outside of your lawn, ready to hang your relatives. That's the same response that she's giving when she sees this. So she's terrified. She's terrorized by this thing.

Terror: What you're seeing on the screen is edited. The view that you're looking at is from her phone. So how the hell you gonna say she didn't see this? This was from her phone. So that's what she saw. That's the reason why she can hardly breathe. That's the reason why she's all choked up, because she sees this maniac. That's what she see. What you just saw on the court records, this is what she saw. Look at his face. Look at the knee on him. That's what she saw. A damn terrorist. That's what she saw.

Terror: Notice what they said under it: warning, some of the images depicted in this video and testimony are graphic. I wrote that at the bottom. I said, notice the description: if this is deemed traumatic for YouTube audience. They have to put that up there. They're saying it's traumatic for YouTube audience. So the video that you just got through looking at, the court records, they had to edit it because YouTube people are watching it. So they're saying basically, if this is deemed too traumatic for YouTube audience, just imagine how traumatic it was for that sister to see that thing straight up with her eyesight. She saw that whole picture of what we just showed earlier. She didn't see the half a thing. That's the reason why she was going hyper, all that stuff going on in her, because she's looking at the whole thing. This is what she saw. That could be my father. That could be my brother. That could be my uncle. That's what she saw. And I got to protect my little baby and put her in the store so she don't see this. That's what she saw. That's the reason why she went in there, and she had to come back out, hoping that her phone worked, and got the film of that long death. Just like Mamie Till had to put aside her own grief to make sure that these bastards deal with her son the proper way. Remember that she had to fight with city officials. She had to put her own grief to the side. Same thing with Darnella. She had to put her own sadness, her own grief, to the side, to make sure that she get this on film. 17 years old, while at the same time trying to protect my young cousin. That's the reason why that sister is responding that way, and that's an act of terror, brothers and sisters.

Terror: So she didn't just see that little short thing. She saw the whole thing there. I'm talking about trauma. Why is it that the screen was cut? Because the people that's controlling the broadcast, they are editors. They know the effect of what goes over the air. They said, we can't show this whole thing. But she saw the whole thing. That's why she's terrorized. Let me show how far this terrorism thing go. How does post trauma work? That's the question. Think about it. It's actually passed down. The trauma that we suffered in slavery goes all the way down to Darnella, and Darnella was trying to prevent it from going even to the younger sister.

Terror: This is the book written by this brother named Richard Williams. The name of the book is called They Stole It But You Must Return It. Chapter three: What did white America do to the black mother? We're gonna show you that the trauma that has been passed down from slavery. The sheriff was a plantation owner. He's the same thing as what we talk about here.

Terror: Trauma is what breaks you in. They broke us in through trauma. The trauma was used to break us, and that's the reason why they do terrorist acts to us: to break our spirit, to cause fear and doubt, to break your will to want to rise up, to break your ability to want to work with your brothers, to break your spirit, to boil you down to a slave where you'll be afraid to move, afraid to do anything. Terrorism is what did this. So when that Bible said what it said, the Lord said that because of our disobedience he will appoint unto us terror. Nobody knows the damn hell that we've seen.

Terror: That's what they did: mold us into accepting a piece of garbage verdict of torment. Justice? 'We can breathe'? You can't breathe. Six people died immediately after that. The hell you mean you got justice? The thing has gotten so bad, to break the minds up so bad, you actually want to get away from what you think is causing the problem. You think your color is causing you the problem, so you go and bleach and destroy yourselves. So the money, the fame and all this now don't mean a damn thing. You still got a hole in your damn head. Broken in your spirits.

Terror: I'm bringing you back to what we dealt with, with Darnella. She did not want her young cousin to be forced to watch this cruel execution. Understand what we're reading. This history is passed down. We nurse punk milk, so you can understand, from our parents being traumatized, and it comes all the way down. We nurse the same fear.

Terror: This is what we gotta think now. The scared stares of her fellow slaves must have been pain to her mind. George Floyd was looking at people trying to help him. Helpless. He's looking in their faces, and he can see in their faces that he saw death in their faces. He's the victim. He's on the ground being choked to death, and he's looking at people that wish that they could save him. All of those people wanted to help him, and he's looking at it, and he sees that they're helpless in helping him, and he's picking that up, that they know that they're helpless. And if they're helpless to help me, I'm surely going to die. That was how he died. But just imagine how Christ died. And when Christ come back, he coming back to kick pure ass, and I'm glad he's coming back with that thing, with his big black feet. Just like George Floyd, it must have been pain in his mind. He could see in the minds of the people that were standing there that they could see death. He could see death on their faces while he was dying.

Terror: Now you see the reason why I went here. The white maniac. The greatest trauma, the greatest pain, was what? Must have been the sight of the white maniac, the slave owner. That's the reason why the sister was responding that way, because when she saw him, that same kind of emotion came over her. She didn't see no little half thing. She saw that, and when she saw that, the same pain that our sister that was tied up on that tree went to her mind. That pain of death, and seeing that knife get ready to come down. It's exactly the knife that's on his neck. That's what you're looking at.

Terror: Just like the little girl. She did not want the little girl to have to witness this. Her young mind, her young psyche, be messed up at 10 years old. No, I'ma try to protect you and send you into Cup Foods store so that you don't have to witness this. Just like it was pain to George Floyd's mind, to see how his people couldn't help him. The people that were standing around the tree, they couldn't help her. It's the same dynamic. The sun that once soothed her must have been pain to her body, because we love the sun, but now this day it's just working against us, because I'm about to die at the hand of this maniac. The greatest pain of all must have been the sight of Derek Chauvin. I'm putting it there. That's the reason why she can't breathe in court: the sight of Derek Chauvin with his knee on that brother, and I couldn't do nothing to save him.

Terror: His knee announced pain and death, and everybody knew it. The martial artist knew it. The fire woman knew it. The bystanders knew it. Everybody knew it. Even when the EMTs came, they said get off of him, because they know that that thing announced pain and death. What did they say? He died later in the hospital. Not account for his life at all. The same kind of treatment. And that would have been the official report. That's why the Most High calls this man a vile demon. He's vile.

Terror: You think you just reading about some old stuff? The same traumas are still happening now, and the sister in the court, she just proved that to you. The same triggers, cause that's how trauma works. I asked the question, how does trauma work? You brutalize, you terrorize people, and any nuance of that incident will bring terror on you. And that's the reason why they drag our people and murder them to death and kill them and do all kind of torture, then show you the thing. Hang your sons up for you to see the dead body. For you to see the strange fruit swinging in the southern breeze. For you to smell the stench of your fathers. For you to remember that. So when these terrible things happen and they're associated with the images that we see, it stays with us, and the very memories of that bring back the trauma. So don't tell us that we don't need no therapy. God got the therapy in the Bible. You devils can't give us no therapy. God's gonna give us a therapy. The therapy is justice, and slavery for all of you, for what you did to us. You're gonna pay for that. That's therapy. That's how we gonna get our minds right, when that gets done to you like you did it to us.

Terror: That's the reason why we as a people can't even get together. We are even afraid to organize among each other. Negroes find a reason to turn against brothers, manufacture stuff, just because they are afraid to break the mode of being terrorized. We are definitely a traumatized people, passed down.

precepts.why:
Now we run scripture about that. When they came and got him, they came into the house. They went and found out who it was.

“For death is come up into our windows”: Death come up to our windows. Philando Castile rolled his window down, and death went into it.

“And is entered into our palaces”: So the people that did that to Emmett Till, they entered into the home of Mamie Till and his father, whose name escapes me right now, to do what? “To cut off the children from without.” And they killed their son. This is what happens to our people, the children of Zion, the children of Israel.

So what the hell you mean that we didn't get treated the worst? The Bible says the worst happened to Israel, happened to us.

“Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us”: That's the curse that happened to us.

“Because we have sinned against him. And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us”: Confirmed by history. So what the hell they mean that the Bible is not true, it's not factual? Even the words in these books that we read is factual, because they're going along with the Bible.

“And against our judges that judged us”: All of Israel caught hell. Our king, everybody went into captivity.

“By bringing upon us a great evil”: This is what the Most High, he brought upon us. Terror.

“For under the whole heaven”: The whole planet, of all mankind, so you can understand.

“Hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem”: So what the hell are they talking about, some six million? This is the real holocaust here. You're gonna pay for that. I know you don't like it, but you're gonna pay for that.

sense.text:
And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow: So when we repent, brothers and sisters, as we repent, the Most High say going to take that spirit of fear from us, going to take that sorrow from us. But a lot of us are too afraid to do that. We find excuses to get away from this re-transformation that the Most High is doing for us.

The Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow: So the Lord shall give us rest from our sorrow. Our inability to even think like men, to even plan, to construct, to build. Sorrow of mind, meaning that you have no vision, no aspirations, can't do nothing. Everything is woe is me. The Most High say gonna take that away from us.

And from thy fear: He's also gonna take away our what? Fear. Fear is driven by terror. So he gonna take that away from us. He's gonna punish those that afflicted us.

And from thy fear: He's gonna give us rest from the fear and the terror that he put upon us for our disobedience. But when we return unto the Lord, he's gonna take all that away from us. It's a shame that brothers and sisters come into the body, learn the scriptures, learn how to get themselves together, and then they get fearful. I understand it's recorded in the Bible. Don't think we're begging you to stay. That's not the point. My point is that any real man and real woman, they're going to make sure that they finish this course, because the Most High is trying to get us the hell out of here. You leave this thing, you're going to die.

And from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve: Where were we made to serve this hard bondage? Right here in this captivity, all over this planet. Everywhere that we serve captivity, the Most High is gonna take us out of there, and he's gonna give us back our homeland.

For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob: Because we need mercy. That sister need mercy, sitting up there, her young self got to witness that kind of thing. She need mercy. We need mercy. We all need mercy. Let us do the right thing and let the Most High work with us to build us up like brothers and sisters.

And will yet choose Israel: As much as we messed up with the Lord, the Lord is only asking us to return and keep his commandments and repent for our sins. And he says, when you do that, I'm going to have mercy on you, because you need mercy with all this kind of hell that we're dealing with. We need some mercy.

And set them in their own land: We're going home, brothers and sisters. That's coming up. Now when I say we're going home, we ain't going home where you got the Israeli Knesset running the government over there. That ain't what we're talking about. When we go over there, it's going to be ours. When we go back, it's going to be ours. That's not prophecy of us trying to go over there now. No. We got Israel over there; we teach them to keep the commandments of the Most High. But none of this is our rest until the Most High bring the destruction to this whole kingdom. Then we can talk about going home.

And the strangers shall be joined with them: This is the other nations. They're going to be made to keep the commandments of the Most High through slavery. We shall bust their backs over with a rod of iron.

And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: We're gonna take our captives and bring them to their place, which is slavery.

And the house of Israel shall possess them: The Israelites, the ones that God's gonna have mercy on, he said that we shall possess the nations.

In the land of the Lord: In the kingdom.

For servants and handmaids: Meaning the kingdom that's going to be on earth as it is in heaven. We're going to possess them.

And they shall take them captives, whose captives they were: We shall take them slaves whose slaves we were. We were their slaves. They're gonna become our slaves.

And they shall rule over their oppressors: So the traumatizing knees of oppression, that's gonna be ended. They're gonna catch complete hell. Who's saying this? The Most High.

The mighty God, even the Lord, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof: So the Most High is getting ready to make some statements on this earth. He wants these words to be heard.

Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined: That's what we're doing. We're the perfection of God's beauty, but you have to be willing to go through the discipline so that you can receive this beauty.

A fire shall devour before him: The Most High gonna burn our enemies up.

And it shall be very tempestuous round about him: The Most High is bringing destruction. You can't play with the Most High. He can really clear the path for his Israelites to rule.

He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people: He's gonna judge us. He's gonna set us in order. That's what he's talking about. He's going to fix us up the way we need to be.

Gather my saints together unto me: The saints, the Israelites. This verse proves it. This is another precept that you're going to use to prove who the saints are.

Gather my saints together: That's a command, that we as the men of God, our job is to go into these streets, go wherever we go, to gather the saints of God together.

Those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice: Those are the ones that I want you to gather. So it ain't talking about gathering all nations. All nations didn't make a covenant with the Most High about sacrifice. The people that made a covenant with God by sacrifice is the children of Israel, the Israelites. That's who the law was given to.
And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: And the heavens shall declare the righteousness of the Most High.

precepts.why:
So we understand that the saints are the Israelites, because those are the ones that made a covenant with God by sacrifice.

“For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people”: For the Lord taketh pleasure in his saints, the Israelites, the ones that made a covenant with the Most High by sacrifice. These are the Israelites.

“He will beautify the meek with salvation”: He will beautify the obedient. That's what that word meek means. He will beautify the obedient with the rulership of the entire planet, including Israel, everywhere.

“Let the saints be joyful in glory”: Let the saints be joyful in the kingdom of heaven. That's what glory is. The glory is the kingdom of heaven. Like when you read in Romans, to whom pertain the adoption and the covenants and the glory. All belongs to Israelites. Everybody else gonna be slaves. I know they don't like it. Don't give a damn.

“Let them sing aloud upon their beds”: Let the Israelites sing aloud upon our beds. We're gonna get some rest that day. The sorrow gonna be gone. The fear gonna be gone. The planet is begging for us to get back in charge, because it's suffering, and it's waiting for the manifestation of us to get our stuff together. And that's what this Bible is talking about doing.

“Let the high praises of God be in their mouth”: Let the high praises of this Bible be in our mouths. We're going to be talking the judgments of God. That's what he's talking about. We're going to be executing that.

“And a twoedged sword in their hand”: The two-edged sword in our hand is a killing instrument, an instrument of obedience. That's what it's gonna be. Instant obedience. Anything that goes against the words of God out of that Bible gonna be instant death.

“To execute vengeance upon the heathen”: To execute vengeance upon the nations. Everybody that's outside of the scriptures gonna get it.

“And punishments upon the people”: And the ones that don't get that sword, they're going into chains.

“To bind their kings with chains”: That's crystal clear. We're going to bind their kings with chains. This is the kind of therapy that Darnella needs. This is the kind of redemption and mind fixing that our people need, that went through all of this trauma. This is how the trauma is gonna be alleviated. Justice. This is the justice here. Get whatever little measure that you can get to make your lives a little easier, but that ain't gonna compare to nothing to what you're actually supposed to get.

“And their nobles with fetters of iron”: Their kings and their popes, all that, they're going into fetters of iron. Iron collars around their neck, around their wrists and ankles. Slavery. Who's saying this? God.

“To execute upon them the judgment written”: To execute upon all the nations the Bible. So you're gonna find out that it's real. In that day, the Bible gonna be executed upon you. The judgment. What is the judgment? He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity. That's going to be executed upon all the nations.

“This honour have all his saints”: This is an honor. The Most High is honoring us. He's going to honor those of us that was afflicted. He's going to honor us with salvation and power, because that's what we need. That's what we're going to get.

sense.text:
He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High: The secret place. So this is letting you know that this place the Most High talk about us dwelling ain't in these multiple churches. The secret place of the Most High is his commandments. These churches ain't teaching you that.

Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty: Under the shadow of the Almighty. We're protected when we keep God's commandments.

I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust: We trust in the Most High. We ain't trusting in your justice system. We ain't trusting in nothing that you got laid out here. We obey the laws and all that, we do all of that, but our trust goes to the Lord. That's the point. Our trust goes to the Most High.

Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler: Surely he will deliver us from our oppressors, from the trauma. They're trying to destroy all of us, with abortions and all types of things. They're trying to destroy all of us. The Most High say going to deliver us from that. It's not an accident that you're still here. You're not still on this earth because of the mercy of the so-called white man. You're here because of God.

Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler: He shall deliver us from the traps.

And from the noisome pestilence: From the sicknesses and the diseases. He's going to deliver us from all of that thing.

He shall cover thee with his feathers: He shall cover us with his protection and his commandments.

And under his wings shalt thou trust: And under his commandments shall we trust. That's what he's talking about.

His truth shall be thy shield and buckler: His commandments. His truth shall be our shield and buckler, because the wages of sin is death. He that keep these commandments, you will have everlasting life. So we gonna be all right, brothers and sisters. Even if they kill us physically in the body, like I always say, you get me now, but I'm coming back to hang your ass. I'm not done. All I got to do is stay in this. I'm good.

Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night: Thou shall not be afraid of what? The terror by night. So we ain't afraid of the knees. We ain't afraid of all of that stuff. But I know our people are, because they've been traumatized with all the stuff that happened with Emmett Till.
